description: One row per municipality: population, GDP, IDHM, fleet and lethal violence (CVLI) indicators for the analysis window. Main table for municipal questions.
IBGE 7-digit municipality code (primary key).
Official municipality name (IBGE). Names repeat across states: always filter or show state_code too.
Two-letter state code (UF), e.g. SP, PE.
Brazilian region: Norte, Nordeste, Sudeste, Sul, Centro-Oeste.
Estimated resident population (IBGE), year in population_year.
Reference year of population.
Reference year of the GDP figures.
GDP at current prices, in thousand BRL (IBGE).
Population year used to compute GDP per capita (closest to gdp_year).
GDP per capita in BRL.
Municipal Human Development Index (0 to 1), year in idhm_year (2010, latest municipal edition).
IDHM education dimension (0 to 1).
IDHM longevity dimension (0 to 1).
IDHM income dimension (0 to 1).
Reference year of IDHM.
Registered vehicle fleet (SENATRAN), month in fleet_reference.
Reference month of the fleet (yyyy-MM).
CVLI victims in the analysis window: intentional homicide, feminicide, robbery followed by death and bodily injury followed by death. Null means no SINESP record.
True when the municipality has SINESP records in the window.
Number of months in the analysis window.
First month of the analysis window.
Last month of the analysis window.
CVLI victims per 100,000 inhabitants, annualized. Main lethal violence indicator.
Z-Score of cvli_rate_100k against municipalities of the same state with population >= 20,000. Null for smaller municipalities.
Z-Score of cvli_rate_100k against all municipalities in Brazil with population >= 20,000. Null for smaller municipalities.
True when cvli_z_score_state >= 2 (stands out within its state).
True when cvli_z_score_national >= 2 (among the highest rates in Brazil).
CVLI rate rescaled to 0-1 (capped at national p1/p99), used in ivsc_score.
1 - IDHM rescaled to 0-1, used in ivsc_score.
Social & Criminal Vulnerability Index, 0 to 1: 0.4 x crime_component + 0.6 x social_component.
National tertile of GDP per capita: Low, Medium, High.

One row per state: lethal violence, vehicle crimes and drug seizures in the analysis window. Use for state-level questions and for vehicle crimes and drug seizures, which SINESP publishes by state only.
Two-letter state code (UF).
State name.
Region code: N, NE, SE, S, CO.
Region name.
State population (sum of municipalities).
State vehicle fleet (sum of municipalities).
State CVLI victims in the window, including victims without informed municipality.
Vehicle robberies and thefts (occurrences) in the window, all reporting agencies.
Seized drugs (cocaine and marijuana) in kg in the window.
Number of months in the analysis window.
First month of the analysis window.
Last month of the analysis window.
State CVLI victims per 100,000 inhabitants, annualized.
Vehicle robberies and thefts per 1,000 vehicles, annualized.
One row per municipality: spatial statistics and graph metrics on the neighborhood graph (municipalities that share a border). Join to municipality_analytics by municipality_code.
IBGE 7-digit municipality code (primary key).
Latitude of a point inside the municipality (SIRGAS 2000).
Longitude of a point inside the municipality (SIRGAS 2000).
Municipality area in km2.
Number of municipalities that share a border with it. 0 for ocean islands.
Average CVLI rate of the neighbors (spatial lag).
Number of neighbors that are national hotspots.
Standardized local Moran statistic from permutations.
Local Moran's I of the Empirical Bayes CVLI rate.
Pseudo p-value of the local Moran's I (999 permutations).

LISA cluster at 5%: High-High (regional violence cluster), Low-Low, High-Low (isolated outlier), Low-High (low rate surrounded by high rates, spillover target), Not significant, No neighbors, No data.
Empirical Bayes standardized CVLI rate (Assuncao & Reis).
Number of neighbors in the graph (same as neighbor_count).
Betweenness centrality in the neighborhood graph (sampled): bridges between regions.
Louvain community id; see graph_communities.
Global Moran's I of the CVLI rate for Brazil (same value on every row).
Pseudo p-value of the global Moran's I (same value on every row).
One row per Louvain community: contiguous groups of municipalities with similar lethal violence levels.
Community id (primary key).
Number of municipalities in the community.
Comma-separated state codes covered by the community.
Total population of the community.
Total CVLI victims in the window.
CVLI victims per 100,000 inhabitants of the community (not annualized).
Public safety event types published by SINESP, with groups and level of detail.
Event key (stable hash of event_name).
Normalized event name (uppercase, no accents), e.g. HOMICIDIO DOLOSO, ROUBO DE VEICULO.
municipal (published per municipality) or state (published per state only).
True for the events that compose CVLI.
True for vehicle robbery and theft.
True for drug seizures (measured in kg).
Months available in the public safety facts.
Month key in yyyyMMdd (first day of month).
First day of the month.
Year.
Quarter (1-4).
Month (1-12).
Month as yyyy-MM.

Event key (dim_event).
Reporting agency: Estadual (state police), Polícia Federal or Polícia Rodoviária Federal.
